0x06552ff3.notice: Runs the access-control + reentrancy-guard + CCTP-adapter initializers. MUST be invoked via the diamond's `initialize` `_init` delegatecall.

params.admin: The address granted `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` (controls every adapter setter).
params.usdc: The deployed USDC token bridged by CCTP.

natspec.notice: One-shot initializer for a Circle CCTP v2 USDC token-bridge diamond — seeds AccessControl (so the chain-domain and per-domain config setters are `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE`-gated), the reentrancy guard (the burn path is `nonReentrant`), and wires the deployed CCTP TokenMessenger + MessageTransmitter + USDC (registering the ICCTPBridgeAdapter interface via ERC-165). Delegatecalled by {Diamond.initialize} inside the initializing window (so it must NOT open its own pre/postInitializer; each `__*_init` guard passes because the window is already open). Reverts `CCTPZeroAddress` if any of the three CCTP addresses is zero.
